source_name: ARAD-REST-API documentation (ČNB)
why_relevant: Technical contract for machine access to ARAD: the REST service exposes the same indicator set and values as the ARAD web application, making automated long-term collection of CZ payment/card/cash series feasible without scraping.

source_name: Zákon č. 136/2011 Sb. o oběhu bankovek a mincí (full text on ČNB)
why_relevant: Legal frame that creates the cash-handling licensing regime, the obligation to accept cash, and the reporting duties of processors — explains why certain datasets exist and who must file them.

source_name: ČNB – Zpráva o finanční stabilitě (Financial Stability Report)
why_relevant: Semi-annual analytical report on the CZ banking sector's health, profitability and structure — context for bank IT/infrastructure spending capacity and for sector consolidation signals relevant to payments vendors.

source_name: ČNB – Výroční zpráva (Annual Report)
why_relevant: Annual consolidated narrative on currency issuance, payment system operation (CERTIS, instant payments), supervision and financial-market structure. Useful for year-over-year framing and for catching numbers not exposed as ARAD series.

source_name: Policie ČR – platby přes platební terminály / acquiring contract annexes
why_relevant: A large state card-acceptance estate (fines paid by card) with published acquiring contract annexes and operating instructions. Combined with the corresponding entry in the contract register it evidences which acquirer serves the state and on what terms – a rare public window on Czech acquiring pricing.

entity_name: Mastercard Czech Republic consumer payment surveys
source_name: Mastercard Rules (public rulebook, Chapter 13 Europe Region)
why_relevant: Chapter 13 covers Europe-Region licensing and central acquiring, which governs how non-CZ acquirers can serve Czech merchants — a structural driver of the CZ acceptance market that no local source states explicitly.

entity_name: Mastercard Czech Republic consumer payment surveys
source_name: Mastercard – Czech Republic Domestic Interchange Fees (11Czech.pdf)
why_relevant: Mastercard's CZ intra-country interchange schedule for Mastercard/Maestro POS and ATM transactions — the counterpart to the Visa CZ rate card and the second half of any CZ card-economics picture.

source_name: Komerční banka – Klientský formát pro QR platbu (bank implementation spec)
why_relevant: Bank-level implementation of the ČBA QR standard; shows which optional SPAYD attributes a major scheme-rail bank supports and how the standard evolves in practice.

source_name: Česká bankovní asociace – Standard ČBA č. 26 (QR kódy / QR Platba)
why_relevant: Authoritative CZ QR-payment standard document (format for sharing CZK payment data via QR codes) issued by the banking association — the normative basis of QR Platba/SPAYD.

source_name: ČSOB – results press releases (tiskové zprávy PDF, e.g. tz260212.pdf)
why_relevant: ČSOB's quarterly/annual results releases quantify digital-channel adoption (ČSOB Smart active mobile users ~1.58m, Kate assistant unique users) plus loan/deposit aggregates — the digital-payments-behaviour proxy for the second-largest CZ bank.

source_name: ČSOB acquiring – merchant manual for card acceptance (platbakartou.csob.cz)
why_relevant: Acquirer merchant manuals enumerate which scheme brands are actually accepted on CZ terminals (Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, Diners/Discover, JCB, UnionPay, Amex) and the scheme rules as operationalised locally — a ground-truth read on scheme presence in CZ acceptance.

source_name: Deloitte CEE Banking M&A Study
why_relevant: Annual study covering 16 CEE countries with a Czech chapter; supplies market-structure data (sector size ranking, concentration, profitability, capital adequacy, deal flow) used to size and segment the CZ banking market. Referenced in Deloitte CZ press releases as the 8th edition tracking CZ as second-largest CEE market.

source_name: ECB Payments statistics press releases (semi-annual, e.g. first half of 2025)
why_relevant: Release-calendar anchor and narrative interpretation of each new payments-statistics vintage; flags revisions, breaks and country-level outliers. Gives the exact publication timing to schedule CZ data pulls and provides EU-wide context for CZ card/terminal trends.

source_name: ECB ERPB – Status Update on SCT Inst scheme and QR-code standardisation
why_relevant: Recurring ERPB status papers track instant-payment adherence shares by country and the European QR-code standardisation work that will interact with the Czech QR Platba/SPAYD standard.

source_name: Visa Core Rules and Visa Product and Service Rules (public edition)
why_relevant: Europe-Region chapters define what CZ acquirers, issuers and merchants may do — acceptance obligations, contactless/CVM limits, Click to Pay, central acquiring. Rule changes are leading indicators of CZ market-structure shifts.

source_name: Institut klinické a experimentální medicíny (IKEM) cash-in-transit tender – template public-hospital buyer
why_relevant: Concrete confirmed example of a state institution tendering 'chráněná pozemní přeprava hotovosti a cenin a zpracování hotovosti'. Demonstrates the searchable phrasing and shows that hospitals, universities and similar bodies are a repeatable population of CIT/cash-processing buyers whose notices reveal collection frequencies and site counts.

source_name: BIS CPMI — 'Payment systems in the Czech Republic' (Red Book country study, d25)
why_relevant: Dedicated BIS Red Book country monograph on the Czech payment system — the deepest supranational structural description of CZ clearing/settlement ever published by BIS. Historic (first CZ edition), so use as a baseline/definitional reference and for institutional lineage, not current figures.

source_name: NIQ Shopper Trends (CZ coverage)
why_relevant: Annual syndicated shopper study whose country coverage includes the Czech Republic, tracking channel shift and checkout behaviour; free abstract pages state scope and can reveal payment-method modules.

source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR – legislative materials on payments (důvodové zprávy, consultation papers)
why_relevant: Explanatory memoranda to payment-services bills contain regulatory impact assessments with counts of licensed entities, transaction and card volumes and cost estimates — quantitative market facts embedded in legislative drafting rather than in statistics releases.

source_name: Aktuálně.cz – Euronet rural ATM rollout and municipal subsidy reporting
why_relevant: Documents the IAD-to-municipality commercial model (monthly fee paid by the obec to host an ATM) and estate splits between tourist and rural locations — quantified evidence for how the non-bank ATM estate is financed.

entity_name: GoPay blog / payment methods & technology category
source_name: GoPay blog – history of payment cards in Czechia (scheme milestone chronology)
why_relevant: Consolidates scheme entry dates and acceptance milestones in the Czech market (first card payments, contactless launch in June 2011, brand arrivals) — useful for dating scheme-level structural changes when the schemes' own archives have been pruned.

source_name: iROZHLAS / Czech Radio – data reporting on municipalities losing branches and ATMs
why_relevant: Public-service broadcaster data journalism mapping municipalities without bank branches or ATMs and the alternatives banks offer; typically sourced from bank questionnaires, so it surfaces numbers not otherwise published.

source_name: SBK annual press release distributed via ČTK Protext / ČeskéNoviny
why_relevant: Full-text mirror of SBK's yearly sector release (card turnover vs ATM withdrawal value, e.g. CZK 1.784tn merchant volume vs CZK 853bn ATM withdrawals in 2024). Useful when the association's own site lags or paywalls detail.

source_name: Visa – Czech Republic Domestic Multilateral Interchange Fees (PDF series)
why_relevant: The actual CZ consumer/commercial interchange rate card — debit/credit/commercial splits, contactless and card-not-present differentials. Core economics input for acquiring and terminal-market analysis; not published by CNB.

source_name: Worldline – Indicative Card Scheme Fee Rates, Czech Republic
why_relevant: Scheme fees (as opposed to interchange) are not published by Visa/Mastercard themselves; a large acquirer's CZ-specific indicative scheme-fee schedule is the practical proxy disclosure, itemising per-transaction and ad-valorem scheme charges applicable in Czechia.

source_name: AKAT – legacy site archive (akatcr-puvodni.cz)
why_relevant: Old AKAT website still serving historical press releases and statistics PDFs (e.g. custodian securities-value releases). Useful for back-filling time series that the redesigned site may no longer expose.

source_name: CMS – Emerging Europe M&A Report, banking & finance chapter
why_relevant: Annual professional-services (law firm + EMIS data) analysis of CEE banking/finance deal flow with country breakouts; a free analyst synthesis of CZ banking-sector consolidation that complements the paid Deloitte M&A study.

source_name: Datalook.cz – Shoptet platform/company data report
why_relevant: Third-party company/market data profiles that can corroborate platform scale claims (merchant counts, financials) used to weight Shoptet-derived acceptance statistics.

source_name: Dopravní podnik hl. m. Prahy – contactless fare payment programme pages
why_relevant: Municipal transport operator documenting its self-service contactless payment device rollout (terminals at middle doors of all trams, self-service ticket machines), with partners ČSOB, Mastercard and Mikroelektronika named in city communications. Provides deployed device counts and supplier identity to interpret the corresponding tenders.

source_name: FinTech Roadmap (Fintree / ČNB congress centre) — annual Czech fintech conference
why_relevant: Fifth edition held 14 May 2026 at the Czech National Bank congress centre, sold out with 400+ participants and 40+ speakers from fintechs, banks, investors, regulators. Speaker roster and session list is a high-density actor map and an early read on regulatory and product direction; the ČNB venue signals regulator engagement.

entity_name: Global Banking Innovation Forum & EXPO Prague
source_name: Global Banking Innovation Forum & EXPO Prague (event listing via 10times)
why_relevant: International banking-innovation event hosted in Prague (21–22 April 2026, Cubex Centrum). Exhibitor and sponsor lists identify vendors actively selling into Czech banks — a supply-side signal for core/card platform migrations.

source_name: GlobalData / Research and Markets – Czech Republic Cards and Payments (Opportunities and Risks to 2028)
why_relevant: The classic paid CZ cards-and-payments report: card volumes and values, split by instrument (cards, cash, direct debit, credit transfer, cheques), historic and forecast. Its distributor press release on GlobeNewswire is a free abstract carrying the scope and often a few headline figures — exactly the 'paid abstract' pathway this cell targets.

source_name: Inspirum blog — nezávislé srovnání poskytovatelů platebních terminálů
why_relevant: Vendor-comparison write-up of CZ payment-terminal providers with pricing and provider landscape; commercially motivated but a rare consolidated public view of acquirer/terminal-provider competition in CZ.

source_name: LobbyFacts / EU Transparency Register datacard – Česká bankovní asociace
why_relevant: Reveals ČBA indirectly: EU Transparency Register filings disclose declared budget, staff, EU-level policy interests and meeting records. Useful for gauging the association's capacity and priorities, and for detecting which payment-policy files it is actively working — information the association's own site does not present.

source_name: Revo/Attitudes toward payment methods – international survey, Czech report (cs PDF)
why_relevant: A full Czech-language commissioned survey report on attitudes to payment methods (May 2022 wave) published openly as a PDF — an example of vendor-commissioned research that is freely downloadable in full rather than abstract-only, with question-level detail on payment-method preference.

source_name: Temenos - press releases and success stories
why_relevant: Documents the largest CZ core-banking replacement on record: Komercni banka live on Temenos Transact (Temenos Core + Data Hub since 2021), first phase in under 12 months with implementation partner Syncordis, phased retail migration targeted for completion end-2025. Names both the platform vendor and the SI - information KB itself discloses only in fragments.
